# `mean`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
mean(expr)
```

Returns the mean calculated from values of a group.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- mean, example 1
> SELECT mean(col) FROM VALUES (1), (2), (3) AS tab(col);
2.0
```

```sql
-- mean, example 2
> SELECT mean(col) FROM VALUES (1), (2), (NULL) AS tab(col);
1.5
```
